properties.name: ironlog:scope
properties.value: Current repository-declared appliance plus explicitly labeled development/build alternatives; registry snapshot is supplemental, not deployment attestation.

properties.name: ironlog:inventory:scope
properties.value: Constituent software only; Ironlog deployment/configuration bundle excluded as a separate software product

properties.name: ironlog:license:policy
properties.value: Runtime components carry OSI-approved primary licenses (Apache-2.0, AGPL-3.0-only, MPL-2.0). HyperDX and MongoDB (SSPL-1.0) were removed 2026-11-03; no SSPL exception is needed.

properties.name: ironlog:knownGaps
properties.value: Exact shipping AMI/RPM/base-system inventory unavailable. | Grafana plugin version pinned (4.23.4) but plugin artifact not scanned. | Transitive license coverage incomplete; image scanners do not establish total FOSS compliance. | No supplier SF-328, ownership/control disclosures or agency FOCI determination. | No vulnerability, malware, reproducible-build or runtime-egress attestation.

properties.name: ironlog:profileSemantics
properties.value: Declaration inventory across labeled profiles; RHEL and Rocky are alternatives. Not one installed appliance.

components.name: ClickHouse Server
components.description: Exact 26.8 LTS build tag. Upstream Apache license does not license every bundled library. Foreign investment disclosed; no current cap table/control rights supplied. Deployed as the ironlog image ironlog-clickhouse (images/clickhouse/Dockerfile), built FROM the pinned upstream in "image"; Compose builds it locally (ironlog-clickhouse:local), Quadlets reference quadlet_image. Vulnerability scans and licence evidence still target the upstream reference.

properties.name: ironlog:license:scope
properties.value: primary upstream project only; not entire container or dependency tree

components.name: Grafana OSS
components.description: Image is grafana/grafana (grafana-oss stopped publishing at 13.0.2); default license AGPL-3.0-only per LICENSING.md, with Apache-2.0 directories and third-party licenses. Disclosed GIC investment is historical evidence requiring current ownership review. Deployed as the ironlog image ironlog-grafana (images/grafana/Dockerfile), built FROM the pinned upstream in "image"; Compose builds it locally (ironlog-grafana:local), Quadlets reference quadlet_image. Vulnerability scans and licence evidence still target the upstream reference.
